****Position Specific Description****
 We are seeking a highly self\-motivated Data Scientist to join our AMI 2\.0 strategic initiative, focusing on developing advanced disaggregation models and extracting grid insights from smart meter data. This role will be instrumental in maximizing the value of our existing AMI infrastructure as grid sensors while supporting the transition to next\-generation metering technology. You will work closely with cross\-functional teams to transform raw meter data into actionable intelligence that drives grid modernization and business growth objectives.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Advanced Analytics \& Model Development
   

  

* Design and develop sophisticated disaggregation algorithms to identify individual appliance usage patterns from aggregated smart meter data
* Create machine learning models for AC anomaly detection and HVAC performance optimization
* Build predictive models for grid event analysis and meter response optimization
* Develop algorithms for enhanced load forecasting using high\-resolution AMI data


 AMI 2\.0 Strategic Support
   

  

* Analyze baseline performance of existing meters to identify opportunities for enhanced grid sensing capabilities
* Support the enterprise cyber risk assessment through data\-driven security insights
* Collaborate on AMI enhancements and distributed intelligence testing
* Contribute to ADMS integration improvements through advanced data analytics


 Grid Intelligence \& Insights
   

  

* Extract actionable insights from disaggregated AMI data to support regulated programs and customer engagement
* Develop analytics frameworks for program sales optimization
* Create real\-time grid event detection and response models
* Build customer segmentation models based on energy usage patterns


 Business Value Creation
   

  

* Partner with cross\-functional teams to validate business cases through data analysis
* Support revenue generation initiatives by identifying high\-value customer opportunities
* Develop performance metrics and KPIs for measuring Smart Grid 2\.0 program success
* Provide data\-driven recommendations for strategic technology investments


 Technical Innovation \& Testing
   

  

* Design and execute experiments for proof\-of\-concept development at the Meter Technology Center (MTC)
* Collaborate on iterative testing approaches with "fail fast, learn fast" methodology
* Support vendor evaluation and technology selection through analytical assessment


**Required Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of experience in machine learning and advanced analytics
* Proficiency in Python, R, and SQL for data analysis and model development
* Experience with time series analysis and signal processing techniques
* Knowledge of utility operations and smart grid technologies preferred


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's in Data Science, Statistics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
* Experience with energy disaggregation algorithms and non\-intrusive load monitoring (NILM)
* Background in utility data analytics or grid modernization projects
* Familiarity with AMI systems, SCADA, and ADMS platforms
* Experience with distributed computing frameworks (Spark, Hadoop)
* Understanding of cybersecurity principles in utility environments


 Technical Skills
   

  

* Advanced statistical modeling and machine learning techniques
* Big data analytics and cloud computing platforms
* Data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
* Experience with IoT data streams and real\-time analytics
* Knowledge of utility industry standards and protocols

**Role:** 
 Machine Learning Measurement Analyst
 



**Our Vision:** 
 RigUp is where the best workers power the world’s most successful projects. We are united by a common mission: to deliver services and technology that fundamentally change how skilled workers and the businesses they serve get hard work done.
 



**Job Description:** 




 The Machine Learning Measurement Analyst supports an established, in\-house machine\-learning measurement program within an oil and gas Facilities \& Pipeline organization. The existing framework and technology are already in place. This position will focus on day\-to\-day program oversight, troubleshooting, performance monitoring, and long\-term development and planning to ensure the measurement program continues to operate reliably and effectively. The ideal candidate is a technical, detail\-oriented problem solver who can take ownership of an established measurement program, keep it running reliably, troubleshoot issues as they arise, and help develop the program for future needs.
